content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for ECHS Recruitment 2026 is 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Nursing Assistant, Lab Technician, and Female Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for ECHS Recruitment 2026 is offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the ECHS posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in ECHS Recruitment 2026 is 58 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Nursing Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Nursing Assistant post is Rs. 36,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: For the Lab Technician post, candidates need a B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology) or Matriculation/Higher Secondary (10+2) with Science and a Diploma in Medical Lab Technology.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for ECHS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS: www.echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Which city are these ECHS vacancies located in?
faq.answer: The vacancies are located in Jamnagar and Rajkot, Gujarat.
